public_relations.name: canonical_public_contract_delivery_readiness_v
public_relations.view_definition:
WITH evaluated AS (
         SELECT diagnostics.company_id,
            diagnostics.source_contract_offer_id,
            diagnostics.name,
            diagnostics.product_code,
            diagnostics.customer_type,
            diagnostics.contract_type,
            diagnostics.channel,
            diagnostics.supported_areas_valid,
            diagnostics.invoice_fee_sek,
            diagnostics.pricing_snapshot,
            diagnostics.external_tenant_reference,
            diagnostics.company_status,
            diagnostics.assignment_id,
            diagnostics.assignment_status,
            diagnostics.website_publication_allowed,
            diagnostics.api_publication_allowed,
            diagnostics.channel_id,
            diagnostics.channel_status,
            diagnostics.publication_id,
            diagnostics.publication_status,
            diagnostics.publication_version_id,
            diagnostics.offer_reference,
            diagnostics.publication_version_status,
            diagnostics.locked_at,
            diagnostics.valid_from,
            diagnostics.valid_to,
            diagnostics.content_sha256,
            diagnostics.publication_snapshot,
            diagnostics.snapshot_source_contract_offer_id,
            diagnostics.public_offer_id,
            diagnostics.website_enabled,
            diagnostics.website_cta_enabled,
            diagnostics.is_public,
            diagnostics.website_publication_status,
            diagnostics.invoice_fee_component_count,
            diagnostics.invoice_fee_canonical_count,
            diagnostics.invoice_fee_component_amount,
            diagnostics.invoice_fee_ready,
            diagnostics.price_option_count,
            diagnostics.default_count,
            diagnostics.required_selection_count,
            diagnostics.invalid_option_count,
            diagnostics.duplicate_option_count,
            diagnostics.legal_ready,
            diagnostics.missing_area_count,
            diagnostics.channel_state,
            diagnostics.blockers,
            diagnostics.visible,
                CASE
                    WHEN diagnostics.channel = 'api'::text THEN diagnostics.publication_version_id IS NOT NULL
                    ELSE diagnostics.public_offer_id IS NOT NULL AND public_offer.contract_publication_version_id = diagnostics.publication_version_id
                END AS forward_publication_link_valid,
                CASE
                    WHEN diagnostics.channel = 'api'::text THEN diagnostics.publication_version_id IS NOT NULL
                    ELSE diagnostics.public_offer_id IS NOT NULL AND publication_version.legacy_public_contract_offer_id = diagnostics.public_offer_id
                END AS reverse_legacy_link_valid,
            diagnostics.assignment_id IS NOT NULL AND assignment.company_id = diagnostics.company_id AND source_offer.company_id = diagnostics.company_id AS company_chain_valid,
            diagnostics.assignment_id IS NOT NULL AND assignment.contract_product_version_id = source_offer.contract_product_version_id AS tenant_assignment_valid,
            diagnostics.channel_id IS NOT NULL AND contract_channel.channel = diagnostics.channel AND publication.channel = diagnostics.channel AND publication_version.channel = diagnostics.channel AS channel_graph_valid,
            diagnostics.publication_version_id IS NOT NULL AND publication_version.contract_product_version_id = source_offer.contract_product_version_id AS product_version_valid,
            diagnostics.publication_version_id IS NOT NULL AND diagnostics.snapshot_source_contract_offer_id = diagnostics.source_contract_offer_id::text AS source_offer_consistent,
            diagnostics.publication_version_id IS NOT NULL AND diagnostics.content_sha256 = encode(digest(diagnostics.publication_snapshot::text, 'sha256'::text), 'hex'::text) AS snapshot_hash_valid,
            diagnostics.publication_version_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(NULLIF(lower(diagnostics.publication_snapshot ->> 'energy_direction'::text), ''::text), NULLIF(lower(publication_version.energy_direction), ''::text), 'consumption'::text) = COALESCE(NULLIF(lower(source_offer.energy_direction), ''::text), 'consumption'::text) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(lower(publication_version.energy_direction), ''::text), 'consumption'::text) = COALESCE(NULLIF(lower(product_version.energy_direction), ''::text), 'consumption'::text) AS energy_direction_valid,
            diagnostics.publication_version_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(NULLIF(lower(diagnostics.publication_snapshot ->> 'contract_type'::text), ''::text), NULLIF(lower(product_version.contract_type), ''::text)) = lower(source_offer.contract_type) AS contract_type_valid,
            NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM contract_offers successor
                  WHERE successor.supersedes_offer_id = diagnostics.source_contract_offer_id AND successor.lifecycle_status = 'published'::text AND successor.is_active)) AS successor_chain_valid
           FROM canonical_public_contract_diagnostics_v diagnostics
             LEFT JOIN contract_offers source_offer ON source_offer.id = diagnostics.source_contract_offer_id
             LEFT JOIN contract_product_versions product_version ON product_version.id = source_offer.contract_product_version_id
             LEFT JOIN tenant_contract_assignments assignment ON assignment.id = diagnostics.assignment_id
             LEFT JOIN tenant_contract_channels contract_channel ON contract_channel.id = diagnostics.channel_id
             LEFT JOIN contract_publications publication ON publication.id = diagnostics.publication_id
             LEFT JOIN contract_publication_versions publication_version ON publication_version.id = diagnostics.publication_version_id
             LEFT JOIN public_contract_offers public_offer ON public_offer.id = diagnostics.public_offer_id
        ), classified AS (
         SELECT evaluated.company_id,
            evaluated.source_contract_offer_id,
            evaluated.name,
            evaluated.product_code,
            evaluated.customer_type,
            evaluated.contract_type,
            evaluated.channel,
            evaluated.supported_areas_valid,
            evaluated.invoice_fee_sek,
            evaluated.pricing_snapshot,
            evaluated.external_tenant_reference,
            evaluated.company_status,
            evaluated.assignment_id,
            evaluated.assignment_status,
            evaluated.website_publication_allowed,
            evaluated.api_publication_allowed,
            evaluated.channel_id,
            evaluated.channel_status,
            evaluated.publication_id,
            evaluated.publication_status,
            evaluated.publication_version_id,
            evaluated.offer_reference,
            evaluated.publication_version_status,
            evaluated.locked_at,
            evaluated.valid_from,
            evaluated.valid_to,
            evaluated.content_sha256,
            evaluated.publication_snapshot,
            evaluated.snapshot_source_contract_offer_id,
            evaluated.public_offer_id,
            evaluated.website_enabled,
            evaluated.website_cta_enabled,
            evaluated.is_public,
            evaluated.website_publication_status,
            evaluated.invoice_fee_component_count,
            evaluated.invoice_fee_canonical_count,
            evaluated.invoice_fee_component_amount,
            evaluated.invoice_fee_ready,
            evaluated.price_option_count,
            evaluated.default_count,
            evaluated.required_selection_count,
            evaluated.invalid_option_count,
            evaluated.duplicate_option_count,
            evaluated.legal_ready,
            evaluated.missing_area_count,
            evaluated.channel_state,
            evaluated.blockers,
            evaluated.visible,
            evaluated.forward_publication_link_valid,
            evaluated.reverse_legacy_link_valid,
            evaluated.company_chain_valid,
            evaluated.tenant_assignment_valid,
            evaluated.channel_graph_valid,
            evaluated.product_version_valid,
            evaluated.source_offer_consistent,
            evaluated.snapshot_hash_valid,
            evaluated.energy_direction_valid,
            evaluated.contract_type_valid,
            evaluated.successor_chain_valid,
            evaluated.forward_publication_link_valid AND evaluated.reverse_legacy_link_valid AND evaluated.company_chain_valid AND evaluated.tenant_assignment_valid AND evaluated.channel_graph_valid AND evaluated.product_version_valid AND evaluated.source_offer_consistent AND evaluated.snapshot_hash_valid AND evaluated.energy_direction_valid AND evaluated.contract_type_valid AND evaluated.successor_chain_valid AS structural_graph_consistent,
            evaluated.publication_version_id IS NOT NULL AND evaluated.publication_id IS NOT NULL AND evaluated.assignment_id IS NOT NULL AND evaluated.channel_id IS NOT NULL AS graph_evaluable
           FROM evaluated
        )
 SELECT company_id,
    source_contract_offer_id,
    name,
    product_code,
    customer_type,
    contract_type,
    channel,
    supported_areas_valid,
    invoice_fee_sek,
    pricing_snapshot,
    external_tenant_reference,
    company_status,
    assignment_id,
    assignment_status,
    website_publication_allowed,
    api_publication_allowed,
    channel_id,
    channel_status,
    publication_id,
    publication_status,
    publication_version_id,
    offer_reference,
    publication_version_status,
    locked_at,
    valid_from,
    valid_to,
    content_sha256,
    publication_snapshot,
    snapshot_source_contract_offer_id,
    public_offer_id,
    website_enabled,
    website_cta_enabled,
    is_public,
    website_publication_status,
    invoice_fee_component_count,
    invoice_fee_canonical_count,
    invoice_fee_component_amount,
    invoice_fee_ready,
    price_option_count,
    default_count,
    required_selection_count,
    invalid_option_count,
    duplicate_option_count,
    legal_ready,
    missing_area_count,
    channel_state,
        CASE
            WHEN graph_evaluable AND NOT structural_graph_consistent THEN array_append(array_remove(COALESCE(blockers, '{}'::text[]), 'PUBLICATION_GRAPH_INCONSISTENT'::text), 'PUBLICATION_GRAPH_INCONSISTENT'::text)
            ELSE array_remove(COALESCE(blockers, '{}'::text[]), 'PUBLICATION_GRAPH_INCONSISTENT'::text)
        END AS blockers,
    forward_publication_link_valid,
    reverse_legacy_link_valid,
    company_chain_valid,
    tenant_assignment_valid,
    channel_graph_valid,
    product_version_valid,
    source_offer_consistent,
    snapshot_hash_valid,
    energy_direction_valid,
    contract_type_valid,
    successor_chain_valid,
    structural_graph_consistent AS canonical_graph_consistent,
    company_status = 'active'::text AS tenant_ready,
    assignment_id IS NOT NULL AND assignment_status = 'active'::text AS assignment_ready,
    channel_id IS NOT NULL AND channel_status = 'active'::text AS channel_ready,
    publication_id IS NOT NULL AND publication_status = 'published'::text AS publication_ready,
    publication_version_id IS NOT NULL AND publication_version_status = 'published'::text AND locked_at IS NOT NULL AS publication_version_ready,
    invoice_fee_ready AS canonical_invoice_fee_ready,
    price_option_count > 0 AND default_count = 1 AND invalid_option_count = 0 AND duplicate_option_count = 0 AND missing_area_count = 0 AS price_options_ready,
    legal_ready AS canonical_legal_ready,
    (valid_from IS NULL OR valid_from <= now()) AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > now()) AS date_window_valid,
    channel = 'api'::text OR public_offer_id IS NOT NULL AND website_enabled AND website_cta_enabled AND is_public AND website_publication_status = 'published'::text AS public_offer_ready,
    visible AND structural_graph_consistent AS visible
   FROM classified;

public_relations.name: canonical_public_contract_diagnostics_v
public_relations.view_definition:
WITH channels(channel) AS (
         VALUES ('website'::text), ('api'::text)
        ), graph AS (
         SELECT offer.company_id,
            offer.id AS source_contract_offer_id,
            offer.name,
            COALESCE(product.product_code, 'electricity'::text) AS product_code,
            offer.customer_type,
            offer.contract_type,
            requested.channel,
            cardinality(COALESCE(product_version.price_areas, '{}'::text[])) = 0 OR NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM unnest(COALESCE(product_version.price_areas, '{}'::text[])) area(area)
                  WHERE upper(btrim(area.area)) <> ALL (ARRAY['SE1'::text, 'SE2'::text, 'SE3'::text, 'SE4'::text]))) AND cardinality(COALESCE(product_version.price_areas, '{}'::text[])) = (( SELECT count(DISTINCT upper(btrim(area.area))) AS count
                   FROM unnest(COALESCE(product_version.price_areas, '{}'::text[])) area(area))) AS supported_areas_valid,
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE((publication_version.publication_snapshot -> 'commercial_snapshot'::text) ->> 'invoice_fee_sek'::text, ''::text) ~ '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'::text THEN ((publication_version.publication_snapshot -> 'commercial_snapshot'::text) ->> 'invoice_fee_sek'::text)::numeric
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS invoice_fee_sek,
            COALESCE(publication_version.publication_snapshot -> 'commercial_snapshot'::text, '{}'::jsonb) AS pricing_snapshot,
            company.external_tenant_reference,
            company.status AS company_status,
            assignment.id AS assignment_id,
            assignment.status AS assignment_status,
            assignment.website_publication_allowed,
            assignment.api_publication_allowed,
            channel.id AS channel_id,
            channel.status AS channel_status,
            publication.id AS publication_id,
            publication.status AS publication_status,
            publication_version.id AS publication_version_id,
            publication_version.offer_reference,
            publication_version.status AS publication_version_status,
            publication_version.locked_at,
            publication_version.valid_from,
            publication_version.valid_to,
            publication_version.content_sha256,
            publication_version.publication_snapshot,
            publication_version.publication_snapshot ->> 'source_contract_offer_id'::text AS snapshot_source_contract_offer_id,
            public_offer.id AS public_offer_id,
            public_offer.website_enabled,
            public_offer.website_cta_enabled,
            public_offer.is_public,
            public_offer.publication_status AS website_publication_status,
            COALESCE(invoice_fee.component_count, 0::bigint) AS invoice_fee_component_count,
            COALESCE(invoice_fee.canonical_count, 0::bigint) AS invoice_fee_canonical_count,
            invoice_fee.canonical_amount AS invoice_fee_component_amount,
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE((publication_version.publication_snapshot -> 'commercial_snapshot'::text) ->> 'invoice_fee_sek'::text, ''::text) ~ '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'::text THEN ((publication_version.publication_snapshot -> 'commercial_snapshot'::text) ->> 'invoice_fee_sek'::text)::numeric
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(invoice_fee.component_count, 0::bigint) = 1 AND COALESCE(invoice_fee.canonical_count, 0::bigint) = 1 AND abs(
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE((publication_version.publication_snapshot -> 'commercial_snapshot'::text) ->> 'invoice_fee_sek'::text, ''::text) ~ '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'::text THEN ((publication_version.publication_snapshot -> 'commercial_snapshot'::text) ->> 'invoice_fee_sek'::text)::numeric
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END - invoice_fee.canonical_amount) <= 0.000000001 AS invoice_fee_ready,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM contract_price_options option_row
                  WHERE option_row.contract_publication_version_id = publication_version.id AND option_row.status = 'active'::text) AS price_option_count,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM contract_price_options option_row
                  WHERE option_row.contract_publication_version_id = publication_version.id AND option_row.status = 'active'::text AND option_row.is_default) AS default_count,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM contract_price_options option_row
                  WHERE option_row.contract_publication_version_id = publication_version.id AND option_row.status = 'active'::text AND option_row.selection_required) AS required_selection_count,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM contract_price_options option_row
                  WHERE option_row.contract_publication_version_id = publication_version.id AND option_row.status = 'active'::text AND (option_row.customer_type IS NULL OR NOT (option_row.customer_type = 'both'::text OR offer.customer_type = 'both'::text OR option_row.customer_type = offer.customer_type) OR option_row.contract_type <> offer.contract_type OR option_row.selection_required IS NULL OR NULLIF(btrim(option_row.option_reference), ''::text) IS NULL OR NULLIF(btrim(option_row.option_code), ''::text) IS NULL)) AS invalid_option_count,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM ( SELECT option_row.option_reference AS stable_value
                           FROM contract_price_options option_row
                          WHERE option_row.contract_publication_version_id = publication_version.id AND option_row.status = 'active'::text
                          GROUP BY option_row.option_reference
                         HAVING count(*) > 1
                        UNION ALL
                         SELECT option_row.option_code AS stable_value
                           FROM contract_price_options option_row
                          WHERE option_row.contract_publication_version_id = publication_version.id AND option_row.status = 'active'::text
                          GROUP BY option_row.option_code
                         HAVING count(*) > 1) duplicated) AS duplicate_option_count,
            (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM legal_bundle_versions bundle
                  WHERE bundle.id = publication_version.legal_bundle_version_id AND bundle.company_id = offer.company_id AND (bundle.status = ANY (ARRAY['published'::text, 'replaced'::text, 'archived'::text])) AND bundle.locked_at IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(COALESCE(bundle.unresolved_variables, '{}'::text[])) = 0 AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                           FROM legal_bundle_version_documents document
                          WHERE document.legal_bundle_version_id = bundle.id)))) AS legal_ready,
            COALESCE(( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM unnest(gridex_supported_price_areas_v1(publication_version.contract_product_version_id)) required_area(required_area)
                  WHERE offer.contract_type = 'fixed'::text AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                           FROM contract_price_options option_row
                          WHERE option_row.contract_publication_version_id = publication_version.id AND option_row.status = 'active'::text AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                   FROM contract_price_option_area_prices area_row
                                  WHERE area_row.contract_price_option_id = option_row.id AND area_row.price_area = required_area.required_area AND area_row.status = 'active'::text AND area_row.amount IS NOT NULL AND area_row.amount >= 0::numeric AND (area_row.unit = ANY (ARRAY['ore_per_kwh'::text, 'sek_per_kwh'::text]))))))), 0::bigint) AS missing_area_count
           FROM contract_offers offer
             LEFT JOIN contract_products product ON product.id = offer.contract_product_id
             LEFT JOIN contract_product_versions product_version ON product_version.id = offer.contract_product_version_id
             JOIN companies company ON company.id = offer.company_id
             CROSS JOIN channels requested
             LEFT JOIN tenant_contract_assignments assignment ON assignment.company_id = offer.company_id AND assignment.contract_product_version_id = offer.contract_product_version_id
             LEFT JOIN tenant_contract_channels channel ON channel.assignment_id = assignment.id AND channel.channel = requested.channel
             LEFT JOIN contract_publications publication ON publication.assignment_id = assignment.id AND publication.channel = requested.channel
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT version_row.id,
                    version_row.contract_publication_id,
                    version_row.version_number,
                    version_row.contract_product_version_id,
                    version_row.price_plan_id,
                    version_row.price_plan_version_id,
                    version_row.price_book_id,
                    version_row.legal_bundle_version_id,
                    version_row.legacy_public_contract_offer_id,
                    version_row.customer_type,
                    version_row.channel,
                    version_row.valid_from,
                    version_row.valid_to,
                    version_row.publication_snapshot,
                    version_row.offer_reference,
                    version_row.content_sha256,
                    version_row.status,
                    version_row.published_at,
                    version_row.locked_at,
                    version_row.created_by,
                    version_row.created_at,
                    version_row.energy_direction
                   FROM contract_publication_versions version_row
                  WHERE version_row.contract_publication_id = publication.id AND version_row.contract_product_version_id = offer.contract_product_version_id
                  ORDER BY version_row.version_number DESC
                 LIMIT 1) publication_version ON true
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS component_count,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (component.value ->> 'unit'::text) = 'sek_invoice'::text AND (component.value ->> 'calculation_type'::text) = 'per_invoice'::text AND COALESCE(component.value ->> 'amount'::text, ''::text) ~ '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'::text AND ((component.value ->> 'amount'::text)::numeric) >= 0::numeric) AS canonical_count,
                    max(
                        CASE
                            WHEN (component.value ->> 'unit'::text) = 'sek_invoice'::text AND (component.value ->> 'calculation_type'::text) = 'per_invoice'::text AND COALESCE(component.value ->> 'amount'::text, ''::text) ~ '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'::text AND ((component.value ->> 'amount'::text)::numeric) >= 0::numeric THEN (component.value ->> 'amount'::text)::numeric
                            ELSE NULL::numeric
                        END) AS canonical_amount
                   FROM jsonb_array_elements(
                        CASE
                            WHEN jsonb_typeof((publication_version.publication_snapshot -> 'commercial_snapshot'::text) -> 'price_components'::text) = 'array'::text THEN (publication_version.publication_snapshot -> 'commercial_snapshot'::text) -> 'price_components'::text
                            WHEN jsonb_typeof((publication_version.publication_snapshot -> 'commercial_snapshot'::text) -> 'price_components_snapshot'::text) = 'array'::text THEN (publication_version.publication_snapshot -> 'commercial_snapshot'::text) -> 'price_components_snapshot'::text
                            ELSE '[]'::jsonb
                        END) component(value)
                  WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(component.value ->> 'component_code'::text, ''::text), NULLIF(component.value ->> 'component_type'::text, ''::text), NULLIF((component.value -> 'metadata'::text) ->> 'component_code'::text, ''::text)) = 'invoice_fee'::text AND COALESCE(NULLIF(component.value ->> 'status'::text, ''::text), 'active'::text) = 'active'::text) invoice_fee ON true
             LEFT JOIN public_contract_offers public_offer ON requested.channel = 'website'::text AND public_offer.company_id = offer.company_id AND public_offer.source_contract_offer_id = offer.id AND public_offer.contract_publication_version_id = publication_version.id
        )
 SELECT company_id,
    source_contract_offer_id,
    name,
    product_code,
    customer_type,
    contract_type,
    channel,
    supported_areas_valid,
    invoice_fee_sek,
    pricing_snapshot,
    external_tenant_reference,
    company_status,
    assignment_id,
    assignment_status,
    website_publication_allowed,
    api_publication_allowed,
    channel_id,
    channel_status,
    publication_id,
    publication_status,
    publication_version_id,
    offer_reference,
    publication_version_status,
    locked_at,
    valid_from,
    valid_to,
    content_sha256,
    publication_snapshot,
    snapshot_source_contract_offer_id,
    public_offer_id,
    website_enabled,
    website_cta_enabled,
    is_public,
    website_publication_status,
    invoice_fee_component_count,
    invoice_fee_canonical_count,
    invoice_fee_component_amount,
    invoice_fee_ready,
    price_option_count,
    default_count,
    required_selection_count,
    invalid_option_count,
    duplicate_option_count,
    legal_ready,
    missing_area_count,
        CASE
            WHEN channel_id IS NULL THEN 'missing'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(channel_status, 'missing'::text) <> 'active'::text THEN 'inactive'::text
            WHEN publication_version_id IS NULL THEN 'missing'::text
            WHEN valid_to IS NOT NULL AND valid_to <= now() THEN 'expired'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(publication_version_status, 'missing'::text) = 'draft'::text THEN 'draft'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(publication_version_status, 'missing'::text) = 'review'::text THEN 'preparing'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(publication_version_status, 'missing'::text) = 'published'::text AND (company_status <> 'active'::text OR NULLIF(btrim(external_tenant_reference), ''::text) IS NULL OR assignment_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(assignment_status, 'missing'::text) <> 'active'::text OR channel_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(channel_status, 'missing'::text) <> 'active'::text OR channel = 'website'::text AND NOT COALESCE(website_publication_allowed, false) OR channel = 'api'::text AND NOT COALESCE(api_publication_allowed, false) OR publication_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(publication_status, 'missing'::text) <> 'published'::text OR snapshot_source_contract_offer_id IS DISTINCT FROM source_contract_offer_id::text OR locked_at IS NULL OR content_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(digest(publication_snapshot::text, 'sha256'::text), 'hex'::text) OR price_option_count = 0 OR default_count <> 1 OR price_option_count = 1 AND required_selection_count <> 0 OR price_option_count > 1 AND required_selection_count <> price_option_count OR invalid_option_count > 0 OR duplicate_option_count > 0 OR NOT supported_areas_valid OR missing_area_count > 0 OR NOT legal_ready OR NOT invoice_fee_ready OR valid_from IS NOT NULL AND valid_from > now() OR channel = 'website'::text AND (public_offer_id IS NULL OR NOT COALESCE(website_enabled, false) OR NOT COALESCE(website_cta_enabled, false) OR NOT COALESCE(is_public, false) OR COALESCE(website_publication_status, 'missing'::text) <> 'published'::text)) THEN 'blocked'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(publication_version_status, 'missing'::text) = 'published'::text THEN 'published'::text
            WHEN publication_version_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'blocked'::text
            ELSE 'error'::text
        END AS channel_state,
    array_remove(ARRAY[
        CASE
            WHEN company_status <> 'active'::text THEN 'TENANT_NOT_OPERATIONALLY_READY'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN NULLIF(btrim(external_tenant_reference), ''::text) IS NULL THEN 'EXTERNAL_TENANT_REFERENCE_MISSING'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN assignment_id IS NULL THEN 'TENANT_ASSIGNMENT_MISSING'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(assignment_status, 'missing'::text) <> 'active'::text THEN 'TENANT_ASSIGNMENT_INACTIVE'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN channel_id IS NULL THEN upper(channel) || '_CHANNEL_MISSING'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(channel_status, 'missing'::text) <> 'active'::text THEN 'PUBLICATION_CHANNEL_NOT_ACTIVE'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN channel = 'website'::text AND NOT COALESCE(website_publication_allowed, false) THEN 'WEBSITE_PUBLICATION_NOT_ALLOWED'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN channel = 'api'::text AND NOT COALESCE(api_publication_allowed, false) THEN 'API_PUBLICATION_NOT_ALLOWED'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN publication_id IS NULL THEN 'PUBLICATION_MISSING'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(publication_status, 'missing'::text) <> 'published'::text THEN 'PUBLICATION_NOT_PUBLISHED'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN publication_version_id IS NULL THEN 'PUBLICATION_VERSION_MISSING'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN publication_version_id IS NOT NULL AND snapshot_source_contract_offer_id IS DISTINCT FROM source_contract_offer_id::text THEN 'PUBLICATION_SOURCE_OFFER_MISMATCH'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(publication_version_status, 'missing'::text) <> 'published'::text THEN 'PUBLICATION_VERSION_NOT_PUBLISHED'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN locked_at IS NULL THEN 'PUBLICATION_VERSION_NOT_LOCKED'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN publication_version_id IS NOT NULL AND content_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(digest(publication_snapshot::text, 'sha256'::text), 'hex'::text) THEN 'PUBLICATION_SNAPSHOT_INVALID'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN price_option_count = 0 THEN 'PUBLICATION_PRICE_OPTIONS_MISSING'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN duplicate_option_count > 0 THEN 'PUBLICATION_PRICE_OPTION_DUPLICATE'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN default_count <> 1 THEN 'PUBLICATION_PRICE_OPTION_DEFAULT_INVALID'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN price_option_count = 1 AND required_selection_count <> 0 OR price_option_count > 1 AND required_selection_count <> price_option_count THEN 'PUBLICATION_PRICE_OPTION_SELECTION_POLICY_INVALID'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN invalid_option_count > 0 THEN 'PUBLICATION_PRICE_OPTION_POLICY_INVALID'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT supported_areas_valid THEN 'PUBLICATION_SUPPORTED_PRICE_AREA_INVALID'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN missing_area_count > 0 THEN 'PUBLICATION_AREA_PRICES_MISSING'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT legal_ready THEN 'PUBLICATION_LEGAL_BUNDLE_MISSING'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT invoice_fee_ready THEN 'INVOICE_FEE_CONFIGURATION_MISSING'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN valid_from IS NOT NULL AND valid_from > now() THEN 'PUBLICATION_NOT_YET_VALID'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN valid_to IS NOT NULL AND valid_to <= now() THEN 'PUBLICATION_EXPIRED'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN channel = 'website'::text AND public_offer_id IS NULL THEN 'WEBSITE_PUBLIC_OFFER_MISSING'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN channel = 'website'::text AND NOT COALESCE(website_enabled, false) THEN 'WEBSITE_DISABLED'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN channel = 'website'::text AND NOT COALESCE(website_cta_enabled, false) THEN 'WEBSITE_CTA_DISABLED'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN channel = 'website'::text AND NOT COALESCE(is_public, false) THEN 'WEBSITE_NOT_PUBLIC'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN channel = 'website'::text AND COALESCE(website_publication_status, 'missing'::text) <> 'published'::text THEN 'WEBSITE_PUBLICATION_NOT_PUBLISHED'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END], NULL::text) AS blockers,
    cardinality(array_remove(ARRAY[
        CASE
            WHEN company_status <> 'active'::text THEN 'x'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN NULLIF(btrim(external_tenant_reference), ''::text) IS NULL THEN 'x'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN assignment_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(assignment_status, 'missing'::text) <> 'active'::text THEN 'x'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN channel_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(channel_status, 'missing'::text) <> 'active'::text THEN 'x'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN channel = 'website'::text AND NOT COALESCE(website_publication_allowed, false) THEN 'x'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN channel = 'api'::text AND NOT COALESCE(api_publication_allowed, false) THEN 'x'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN publication_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(publication_status, 'missing'::text) <> 'published'::text THEN 'x'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN publication_version_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(publication_version_status, 'missing'::text) <> 'published'::text THEN 'x'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN publication_version_id IS NOT NULL AND snapshot_source_contract_offer_id IS DISTINCT FROM source_contract_offer_id::text THEN 'x'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN locked_at IS NULL THEN 'x'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN publication_version_id IS NOT NULL AND content_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(digest(publication_snapshot::text, 'sha256'::text), 'hex'::text) THEN 'x'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN price_option_count = 0 OR default_count <> 1 OR price_option_count = 1 AND required_selection_count <> 0 OR price_option_count > 1 AND required_selection_count <> price_option_count OR invalid_option_count > 0 OR duplicate_option_count > 0 OR NOT supported_areas_valid OR missing_area_count > 0 THEN 'x'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT legal_ready OR NOT invoice_fee_ready THEN 'x'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN valid_from IS NOT NULL AND valid_from > now() THEN 'x'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN valid_to IS NOT NULL AND valid_to <= now() THEN 'x'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN channel = 'website'::text AND (public_offer_id IS NULL OR NOT COALESCE(website_enabled, false) OR NOT COALESCE(website_cta_enabled, false) OR NOT COALESCE(is_public, false) OR COALESCE(website_publication_status, 'missing'::text) <> 'published'::text) THEN 'x'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END], NULL::text)) = 0 AS visible
   FROM graph;

public_relations.name: tenant_website_readiness_v
public_relations.view_definition:
SELECT id AS company_id,
    name AS company_name,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM integration_api_clients i
          WHERE i.company_id = c.id AND i.status = 'active'::text AND i.scopes @> ARRAY['website_contracts.read'::text, 'website_applications.write'::text])) AS has_api_client,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM integration_api_clients i
          WHERE i.company_id = c.id AND i.status = 'active'::text AND COALESCE(array_length(i.allowed_origins, 1), 0) > 0)) AS has_allowed_origin,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM public_contract_offers o
          WHERE o.company_id = c.id AND COALESCE(o.publication_status, 'draft'::text) = 'published'::text AND o.website_enabled = true AND o.is_public = true AND COALESCE(o.is_archived, false) = false AND (o.valid_from IS NULL OR o.valid_from <= CURRENT_DATE) AND (o.valid_to IS NULL OR o.valid_to >= CURRENT_DATE))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM price_plan_versions ppv
             JOIN price_plans pp ON pp.id = ppv.price_plan_id AND pp.company_id = ppv.company_id
          WHERE ppv.company_id = c.id AND (ppv.status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'published'::text])) AND (COALESCE(ppv.snapshot_json ->> 'website_visible'::text, ppv.snapshot_json ->> 'is_public'::text, 'false'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['true'::text, '1'::text])))) AS has_public_contracts,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM legal_text_versions l
          WHERE l.company_id = c.id AND l.type = 'terms'::text AND l.status = 'published'::text)) AS has_terms,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM legal_text_versions l
          WHERE l.company_id = c.id AND l.type = 'privacy_policy'::text AND l.status = 'published'::text)) AS has_privacy_policy,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM legal_text_versions l
          WHERE l.company_id = c.id AND l.type = 'withdrawal'::text AND l.status = 'published'::text)) AS has_withdrawal,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM legal_text_versions l
          WHERE l.company_id = c.id AND l.type = 'power_of_attorney'::text AND l.status = 'published'::text)) AS has_power_of_attorney_text,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM legal_text_versions l
          WHERE l.company_id = c.id AND l.type = 'price_terms'::text AND l.status = 'published'::text)) AS has_price_terms,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM company_email_settings s
          WHERE s.company_id = c.id AND (COALESCE(s.verification_status, ''::text) = ANY (ARRAY['verified'::text, 'completed'::text])))) AS has_verified_sender,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM company_email_templates t
          WHERE t.company_id = c.id AND t.is_active = true)) AS has_mail_templates,
    array_remove(ARRAY[
        CASE
            WHEN NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM integration_api_clients i
              WHERE i.company_id = c.id AND i.status = 'active'::text AND i.scopes @> ARRAY['website_contracts.read'::text, 'website_applications.write'::text])) THEN 'API-klient för hemsida/Mina sidor saknas'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM integration_api_clients i
              WHERE i.company_id = c.id AND i.status = 'active'::text AND COALESCE(array_length(i.allowed_origins, 1), 0) > 0)) THEN 'Tillåten hemsidedomän/origin saknas'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT ((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM public_contract_offers o
              WHERE o.company_id = c.id AND COALESCE(o.publication_status, 'draft'::text) = 'published'::text AND o.website_enabled = true AND o.is_public = true AND COALESCE(o.is_archived, false) = false AND (o.valid_from IS NULL OR o.valid_from <= CURRENT_DATE) AND (o.valid_to IS NULL OR o.valid_to >= CURRENT_DATE))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM price_plan_versions ppv
                 JOIN price_plans pp ON pp.id = ppv.price_plan_id AND pp.company_id = ppv.company_id
              WHERE ppv.company_id = c.id AND (ppv.status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'published'::text])) AND (COALESCE(ppv.snapshot_json ->> 'website_visible'::text, ppv.snapshot_json ->> 'is_public'::text, 'false'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['true'::text, '1'::text]))))) THEN 'Publicerade avtal saknas'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM legal_text_versions l
              WHERE l.company_id = c.id AND l.type = 'terms'::text AND l.status = 'published'::text)) THEN 'Allmänna villkor saknas'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM legal_text_versions l
              WHERE l.company_id = c.id AND l.type = 'privacy_policy'::text AND l.status = 'published'::text)) THEN 'Integritetspolicy saknas'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM legal_text_versions l
              WHERE l.company_id = c.id AND l.type = 'withdrawal'::text AND l.status = 'published'::text)) THEN 'Ångerrättstext saknas'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM legal_text_versions l
              WHERE l.company_id = c.id AND l.type = 'power_of_attorney'::text AND l.status = 'published'::text)) THEN 'Fullmaktstext saknas'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM legal_text_versions l
              WHERE l.company_id = c.id AND l.type = 'price_terms'::text AND l.status = 'published'::text)) THEN 'Prisvillkor saknas'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM company_email_templates t
              WHERE t.company_id = c.id AND t.is_active = true)) THEN 'Aktiva mailmallar saknas'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END], NULL::text) AS missing_items,
    now() AS evaluated_at
   FROM companies c;

 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp'

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gridex_actor_has_company_permission(p_actor_user_id uuid, p_company_id uuid, p_permission text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select p_actor_user_id is not null and p_company_id is not null
  and exists(
    select 1 from auth.users u
    where u.id = p_actor_user_id and u.deleted_at is null
      and (u.banned_until is null or u.banned_until <= now())
  )
  and (
    exists(
      select 1 from public.admin_users au
      where au.user_id = p_actor_user_id
        and coalesce(au.is_active, true)
        and lower(coalesce(au.role, '')) in ('super_admin', 'superadmin', 'platform_superadmin')
    )
    or exists(
      select 1
      from public.user_roles ur left join public.roles r on r.id = ur.role_id
      where ur.user_id = p_actor_user_id and ur.company_id is null
        and coalesce(ur.status, 'active') = 'active' and coalesce(ur.is_active, true)
        and lower(coalesce(ur.role, r.key, r.name, '')) in ('super_admin', 'superadmin', 'platform_superadmin')
    )
    or (
      exists(
        select 1 from public.company_memberships cm
        join public.companies c on c.id = cm.company_id
        where cm.user_id = p_actor_user_id and cm.company_id = p_company_id
          and coalesce(cm.status, 'active') = 'active' and coalesce(cm.is_active, true)
          and coalesce(c.is_active, true)
          and coalesce(c.status, 'active') not in ('archived', 'suspended', 'pending_deletion', 'deleted')
      )
      -- the permission must hold IN THIS COMPANY, not anywhere the user happens to
      -- hold it
      and p_permission = any(
        public.gridex_get_user_permissions_in_company(p_actor_user_id, p_company_id)
      )
    )
  )
$function$

effective_definitions.name: gridex_commit_customer_site_address
effective_definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gridex_commit_customer_site_address(p_company_id uuid, p_customer_id uuid, p_site_id uuid, p_street text, p_postal_code text, p_city text, p_country text, p_care_of text, p_apartment_number text, p_address_normalized text, p_address_hash text, p_source text, p_source_reference text, p_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, p_actor_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_previous_hash text;
  v_address_id uuid;
  v_now timestamptz := now();
  v_address_changed boolean;
  v_previous_source text;
  v_previous_verified boolean;
  v_previous_rank integer;
  v_incoming_rank integer;
  v_keep_authority boolean;
begin
  select address_hash, address_source,
         (address_verified_at is not null or address_verification_method = 'grid_owner_response')
    into v_previous_hash, v_previous_source, v_previous_verified
    from public.customer_sites
   where id = p_site_id and company_id = p_company_id and customer_id = p_customer_id
   for update;
  if not found then raise exception 'customer_site_not_found' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;
  if nullif(btrim(p_address_hash), '') is null then raise exception 'address_hash_required' using errcode = '22023'; end if;

  -- Source authority mirrors lib/customer-sites/addressIntake.ts sourceRank().
  -- Unknown stored/incoming values never trigger a conflict (rank NULL).
  v_previous_rank := case coalesce(v_previous_source, 'import')
    when 'grid_owner_response' then 70 when 'superadmin' then 60 when 'tenant_api' then 50
    when 'manual_intake' then 40 when 'website' then 30 when 'customer_portal' then 20 when 'import' then 10 end;
  v_incoming_rank := case p_source
    when 'grid_owner_response' then 70 when 'superadmin' then 60 when 'tenant_api' then 50
    when 'manual_intake' then 40 when 'website' then 30 when 'customer_portal' then 20 when 'import' then 10 end;

  -- NULL -> canonical hash is the first canonicalization of the address already
  -- present on the site. It is not a later customer address change and must not
  -- stale jobs, requests, grid context or metering context.
  v_address_changed := v_previous_hash is not null and v_previous_hash is distinct from p_address_hash;

  -- F21: repeat the verified-address conflict decision atomically under the
  -- locked row. A lower-ranked source may not replace a verified address.
  if v_address_changed and coalesce(v_previous_verified, false) and v_incoming_rank < v_previous_rank then
    raise exception 'verified_address_conflict' using errcode = 'P0001',
      detail = 'A lower-ranked address source cannot replace a verified facility address.';
  end if;
  -- Same physical address from a lower-ranked source keeps the canonical
  -- source, reference and verification; only receipt/informational fields move.
  v_keep_authority := not v_address_changed and v_previous_hash is not null and v_incoming_rank < v_previous_rank;

  if v_address_changed then
    update public.customer_operation_jobs
       set status = 'needs_review', stale_reason = 'site_address_changed_after_operation_started',
           last_error = 'Anläggningsadressen ändrades. Nätägar- och routinguppgifter har ogiltigförklarats.',
           completed_at = v_now, locked_at = null, locked_by = null, lock_token = null, updated_at = v_now
     where company_id = p_company_id and customer_site_id = p_site_id
       and status in ('queued','running','waiting_response');

    update public.customer_info_requests
       set status = 'manual_review_required', blocker_reason = 'Anläggningsadressen ändrades. Skapa en ny nätägarresolution och begäran.', updated_at = v_now
     where company_id = p_company_id and customer_id = p_customer_id and site_id = p_site_id
       and status in ('draft','ready_to_send','z01_prepared','waiting_for_z02','waiting_for_aperak','waiting_for_contrl');

    update public.grid_owner_information_requests
       set status = 'needs_review',
           last_error_code = 'site_address_changed',
           last_error_message = 'Begäran gäller en tidigare adress och får inte återanvändas.',
           metadata = coalesce(metadata,'{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('stale',true,'stale_at',v_now,'stale_reason','site_address_changed'),
           updated_at = v_now
     where company_id = p_company_id and customer_id = p_customer_id and customer_site_id = p_site_id
       and status in ('draft','ready_to_send','sent','waiting_response','blocked_missing_poa','blocked_missing_grid_owner_contact',
                      'blocked_missing_manual_mailbox','ready_to_send_manual_email','manual_email_queued','manual_email_sent','waiting_manual_response');

    update public.manual_email_outbox o
       set status = case when o.status in ('queued','sending') then 'failed' else o.status end,
           last_error = case when o.status in ('queued','sending') then 'Begäran ogiltigförklarades eftersom anläggningsadressen ändrades.' else o.last_error end,
           updated_at = v_now
      from public.grid_owner_information_requests r
     where o.request_id = r.id and r.company_id = p_company_id and r.customer_site_id = p_site_id
       and o.status in ('queued','sending');
  end if;

  update public.customer_sites
     set street = p_street, postal_code = p_postal_code, city = p_city, country = p_country,
         care_of = p_care_of, apartment_number = p_apartment_number,
         address_normalized = p_address_normalized, address_hash = p_address_hash,
         address_source = case when v_keep_authority then address_source else p_source end,
         address_source_reference = case when v_keep_authority then address_source_reference else p_source_reference end,
         address_received_at = v_now,
         address_verified_at = case when v_keep_authority then address_verified_at when p_source = 'grid_owner_response' then v_now else null end,
         address_verification_method = case when v_keep_authority then address_verification_method when p_source = 'grid_owner_response' then 'grid_owner_response' else null end,
         address_confidence = case when v_keep_authority then address_confidence when p_source = 'grid_owner_response' then 1 else null end,
         address_status = case when v_keep_authority then address_status when p_source = 'grid_owner_response' then 'verified' else 'candidate' end,
         address_quality_status = 'complete', address_quality_warnings = '[]'::jsonb,
         -- Canonical grid context is always derived by the resolver or a verified
         -- grid-owner response. Claimed values remain evidence in metadata only.
         grid_owner_id = case when v_address_changed then null else grid_owner_id end,
         selected_grid_owner_id = case when v_address_changed then null else selected_grid_owner_id end,
         grid_area_code = case when v_address_changed then null else grid_area_code end,
         price_area_code = case when v_address_changed then null else price_area_code end,
         bidding_zone_code = case when v_address_changed then null else bidding_zone_code end,
         resolution_id = case when v_address_changed then null else resolution_id end,
         resolution_status = case when v_address_changed then 'pending_resolution' else resolution_status end,
         resolution_confidence = case when v_address_changed then null else resolution_confidence end,
         facility_data_status = case when v_keep_authority then facility_data_status when p_source = 'grid_owner_response' then 'verified' when v_address_changed then 'unverified' else facility_data_status end,
         metadata = coalesce(metadata,'{}'::jsonb) || coalesce(p_metadata,'{}'::jsonb), updated_at = v_now
   where id = p_site_id and company_id = p_company_id and customer_id = p_customer_id;

  if v_address_changed then
    update public.metering_points
       set grid_owner_id = null, grid_area_code = null, price_area_code = null,
           verification_status = 'pending_verification', updated_at = v_now
     where company_id = p_company_id and (site_id = p_site_id or customer_site_id = p_site_id) and status <> 'closed';
  end if;

  select id into v_address_id from public.customer_addresses
   where company_id = p_company_id and customer_id = p_customer_id and type = 'facility'
     and metadata @> jsonb_build_object('customer_site_id', p_site_id)
   order by updated_at desc nulls last limit 1 for update;
  if v_address_id is null then
    insert into public.customer_addresses(company_id,customer_id,type,street_1,street_2,postal_code,city,country,is_active,metadata,created_at,updated_at)
    values(p_company_id,p_customer_id,'facility',p_street,p_care_of,p_postal_code,p_city,p_country,true,
      jsonb_build_object('customer_site_id',p_site_id,'address_hash',p_address_hash,'source',p_source),v_now,v_now);
  else
    update public.customer_addresses set street_1=p_street,street_2=p_care_of,postal_code=p_postal_code,city=p_city,country=p_country,
      is_active=true,metadata=jsonb_build_object('customer_site_id',p_site_id,'address_hash',p_address_hash,'source',p_source),updated_at=v_now
    where id=v_address_id;
  end if;

  insert into public.customer_site_address_history(company_id,customer_id,customer_site_id,address_hash,source,source_reference,actor_user_id,snapshot)
  values(p_company_id,p_customer_id,p_site_id,p_address_hash,p_source,p_source_reference,p_actor_user_id,
    jsonb_build_object('street',p_street,'postal_code',p_postal_code,'city',p_city,'country',p_country,'care_of',p_care_of,
      'apartment_number',p_apartment_number,'address_hash',p_address_hash,'source',p_source,'source_reference',p_source_reference,
      'claimed_grid_owner_id',p_metadata->>'claimed_grid_owner_id','claimed_grid_area_code',p_metadata->>'claimed_grid_area_code',
      'claimed_price_area_code',p_metadata->>'claimed_price_area_code','derived_context_invalidated',v_address_changed));
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gridex_create_customer_site_with_address(p_company_id uuid, p_customer_id uuid, p_site_name text, p_facility_id text, p_street text, p_postal_code text, p_city text, p_country text, p_address_normalized text, p_address_hash text, p_source text, p_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_site_id uuid;
  v_now timestamptz := now();
  v_country text := coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_country), ''), 'SE');
  v_site_name text := coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_site_name), ''), 'Anläggning');
  v_claimed_grid_area_code text := nullif(btrim(p_metadata ->> 'claimed_grid_area_code'), '');
  v_claimed_price_area_code text := upper(nullif(btrim(p_metadata ->> 'claimed_price_area_code'), ''));
  v_claimed_grid_owner_id uuid := null;
begin
  if p_company_id is null then
    raise exception 'company_id_required' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  if p_customer_id is null then
    raise exception 'customer_id_required' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  if p_address_hash is null or btrim(p_address_hash) = '' then
    raise exception 'address_hash_required' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  if (p_metadata ->> 'claimed_grid_owner_id') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' then
    v_claimed_grid_owner_id := (p_metadata ->> 'claimed_grid_owner_id')::uuid;
  end if;

  select id
    into v_site_id
    from public.customer_sites
   where company_id = p_company_id
     and customer_id = p_customer_id
     and address_hash = p_address_hash
     and coalesce(is_active, true) = true
   order by created_at asc
   limit 1
   for update;

  if v_site_id is not null then
    update public.customer_sites
       set site_name = coalesce(nullif(btrim(site_name), ''), v_site_name),
           facility_id = coalesce(nullif(btrim(facility_id), ''), nullif(btrim(p_facility_id), '')),
           street = coalesce(nullif(btrim(street), ''), p_street),
           postal_code = coalesce(nullif(btrim(postal_code), ''), p_postal_code),
           city = coalesce(nullif(btrim(city), ''), p_city),
           country = coalesce(nullif(btrim(country), ''), v_country),
           address_normalized = coalesce(nullif(btrim(address_normalized), ''), p_address_normalized),
           address_hash = coalesce(nullif(btrim(address_hash), ''), p_address_hash),
           address_source = coalesce(nullif(btrim(address_source), ''), coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_source), ''), 'website')),
           address_received_at = coalesce(address_received_at, v_now),
           address_status = case when p_source = 'grid_owner_response' then 'verified' else coalesce(address_status, 'candidate') end,
           address_quality_status = coalesce(address_quality_status, 'complete'),
           facility_data_status = coalesce(facility_data_status, case when p_source = 'grid_owner_response' then 'verified' else 'unverified' end),
           resolution_status = coalesce(resolution_status, 'needs_review'),
           grid_owner_id = coalesce(grid_owner_id, v_claimed_grid_owner_id),
           selected_grid_owner_id = coalesce(selected_grid_owner_id, v_claimed_grid_owner_id),
           grid_area_code = coalesce(nullif(btrim(grid_area_code), ''), v_claimed_grid_area_code),
           price_area_code = coalesce(nullif(btrim(price_area_code), ''), v_claimed_price_area_code),
           bidding_zone_code = coalesce(nullif(btrim(bidding_zone_code), ''), v_claimed_price_area_code),
           metadata = coalesce(metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || coalesce(p_metadata, '{}'::jsonb),
           updated_at = v_now
     where id = v_site_id
       and company_id = p_company_id
       and customer_id = p_customer_id;
    return v_site_id;
  end if;

  insert into public.customer_sites (
    company_id,
    customer_id,
    site_name,
    facility_id,
    site_type,
    status,
    is_active,
    street,
    postal_code,
    city,
    country,
    address_normalized,
    address_hash,
    address_source,
    address_received_at,
    address_status,
    address_quality_status,
    address_quality_warnings,
    facility_data_status,
    resolution_status,
    grid_owner_id,
    selected_grid_owner_id,
    grid_area_code,
    price_area_code,
    bidding_zone_code,
    metadata,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  ) values (
    p_company_id,
    p_customer_id,
    v_site_name,
    nullif(btrim(p_facility_id), ''),
    'consumption',
    'draft',
    true,
    p_street,
    p_postal_code,
    p_city,
    v_country,
    p_address_normalized,
    p_address_hash,
    coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_source), ''), 'website'),
    v_now,
    case when p_source = 'grid_owner_response' then 'verified' else 'candidate' end,
    'complete',
    '[]'::jsonb,
    case when p_source = 'grid_owner_response' then 'verified' else 'unverified' end,
    'needs_review',
    v_claimed_grid_owner_id,
    v_claimed_grid_owner_id,
    v_claimed_grid_area_code,
    v_claimed_price_area_code,
    v_claimed_price_area_code,
    coalesce(p_metadata, '{}'::jsonb),
    v_now,
    v_now
  ) returning id into v_site_id;

  insert into public.customer_addresses (
    company_id, customer_id, type, street_1, postal_code, city, country,
    is_active, metadata, created_at, updated_at
  ) values (
    p_company_id, p_customer_id, 'facility', p_street, p_postal_code, p_city,
    v_country, true,
    jsonb_build_object('customer_site_id', v_site_id, 'address_hash', p_address_hash, 'source', p_source),
    v_now, v_now
  );

  insert into public.customer_site_address_history (
    company_id, customer_id, customer_site_id, address_hash, source,
    source_reference, actor_user_id, snapshot
  ) values (
    p_company_id, p_customer_id, v_site_id, p_address_hash,
    coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_source), ''), 'website'), null, null,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'street', p_street,
      'postal_code', p_postal_code,
      'city', p_city,
      'country', v_country,
      'address_hash', p_address_hash,
      'source', p_source,
      'claimed_grid_owner_id', v_claimed_grid_owner_id,
      'claimed_grid_area_code', v_claimed_grid_area_code,
      'claimed_price_area_code', v_claimed_price_area_code
    )
  );

  return v_site_id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gridex_create_external_staff_invitation_v1(p_command jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE membership text;
BEGIN
 PERFORM public.gridex_staff_identity_registration_v1(p_command,true);
 SELECT membership_role INTO membership FROM public.canonical_tenant_access_role_mapping WHERE role_key=p_command->>'role_key' AND is_assignable;
 RETURN public.canonical_create_tenant_invitation(jsonb_build_object('company_id',(p_command->>'company_id')::uuid,'actor_user_id',(p_command->>'actor_user_id')::uuid,
  'api_client_id',(p_command->>'api_client_id')::uuid,'channel','ops','staff_operation','invite','external_staff_identity',true,
  'email',p_command->>'email','full_name',p_command->>'full_name','role_key',p_command->>'role_key','membership_role',membership,
  'idempotency_key',p_command->>'idempotency_key','source','ops_external_staff_bootstrap'));
END $function$

gridex_create_partner_webhook_subscription_v1
